name: Precinct Properties NZ Ltd & Precinct Properties Investments Ltd
summary: Precinct Properties New Zealand Limited, Precinct Properties Investments Limited is the largest owner, manager, developer and investment partner of premium city-centre real estate in Auckland and Wellington. Precinct's markets span office, retail, flexible workspace and living, which includes purpose-built student accommodation and high-end, multi-unit residential development. As at 30 June 2026 on a pro forma basis following completion of the PwC Tower transaction, Precinct's directly held portfolio totals 3.0 billion dollars and Precinct has a further 2.2 billion dollars of committed capital partnering assets under management; Precinct is co-invested in 2.0 billion dollars of these assets,…
